senses.gloss: c. (חָבַט 1) fastening; ח׳ של סנדל thongs of a sandal joined in a knot (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Sandalium).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 12:2:3">Y. Yeb. XII, 12ᵈ</cite> top <he>והן שיהו חו׳ של עץ</he> this means that the thongs be of wood (of the vegetable kingdom; oth. vers. <he>מעמידין</he>, <cite ref="V01028"><he>תרסיות</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 12:2:3">Ib.</cite> <he>נפסקו חֲבָטָיו</he> (omitted <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 4:5">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. IV, 5</cite>, a.

<cite ref="Shabbat 112a">Sabb. 112ᵃ</cite>) if its thongs are broken; <he>נפסקה … אחת מח׳</he> if one set of its thongs is broken; Y. Sabb. V, 8ᵃ <he>חבתיו</he> (corr. acc.; omitted <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 12:14">Tosef. ib. XII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:14">XIII</cite>), 14).
